_comment: The cast's secrets (Expansion 6 F.3, docs/ADVENTURES.md §5.3, §5.6): the patron's kindness and hidden motive (game/story/patrons.py, op 'patron': gift, refuse, forgive, paid, expose), a traitor's tells, the reckoning and the betrayal (game/story/traitors.py, op 'traitor': yield, flee, send, fight, turn; condition 'traitor_tells': tells seen at least), and getting inside a place unseen (the step kind infiltrate, game/story/deeds.py, op 'infiltrate': in, caught; condition 'disguised'). Played by name (weight 0). Words: the tale's, with {patron}, {gift}, {motive_told}, {traitor}, {traitor_full}, {tell}, {doubt}, {why}, {place} and pronouns ({they} walk{s}, {they} {are}).

title: {patron} sends for you
A kindness
Word from {patron}
text: {patron} has heard you are back in {town}, and comes down to the common room in person, which {they} need not have done.
A servant of {patron}'s is waiting at the inn when you come in, and will not hear of your going up before {patron} has seen you.
{patron} finds you at the inn's long table, sits down across from you, and for a while only asks how the road was.
"Whatever comes of it," {they} say{s}, "nobody else came. Take this." It is {gift}.
"It is not much against what you are doing." {They} push{es} it across the table: {gift}.
"For the road," {patron} says, and there is {gift}, and {they} will not take it back.

label: Take it, with your thanks.
result: {patron} looks relieved, as if you had done {them} a kindness by taking it.
"Good," {patron} says. "Good. Now eat something."

label: Refuse it. You have not earned it yet.
result: "Then you'll have it when you have," {patron} says, and means it.
{patron} shakes {their} head at you, and is pleased, and pays for your supper instead.

title: What {patron} did not say
{patron}'s reasons
The other reason
text: {patron} takes you aside, into a room with a shut door, and for a long moment cannot begin.
It is late, and the common room is empty but for you and {patron}, and the wine has done what wine does.
{patron} has been drinking alone. When you sit down, {they} speak{s} as if {they} had been waiting all evening to.
{motive_told}

label: Let it lie. The dead are still dead, whatever {patron}'s reasons.
result: {patron} cannot speak for a while. Then {they} take{s} your hand and hold{s} it.
"Thank you," {patron} says, very quietly.

label: Name your price for keeping it quiet.
result: {patron} pays. {They} do{es} not argue. That is almost worse.
The coin is counted out in silence, and you put it away in silence.

label: {town} should know. Tell them.
result: By noon it is all over {town}. {patron} keeps to {their} house.
You say it in the square, where everyone can hear. Nobody looks at {patron}'s door for the rest of the day.

title: Something is wrong
A small thing
You notice
text: {tell}
You notice it without meaning to, and then cannot stop noticing it. {tell}
It is a small thing, the kind you would let pass. {tell}
{doubt}

label: Say nothing, and watch {traitor}.
result: You say nothing. But you will be watching now.
You keep it to yourself, and the night goes on as nights do.

label: Have it out with {traitor}: make {them} tell you everything.
result: You lay it out, all of it, and watch {traitor}'s face as you do. Before you are done {they} {are} weeping.
"You know," {traitor} says. It is not a question. "Then you had better hear the rest."
fail_result: You have it half said when {traitor} is gone - out of the light and into the dark, running.
{traitor} hears you out with a blank face, and in the morning {they} {are} gone, and the road to {home} has fresh tracks.

label: Send {traitor} away, tonight, and say why.
result: {traitor} does not deny it. {They} only nod{s}, and go{es}.
"I'm sorry," {traitor} says at the end, and it might even be true.

label: Draw steel. {traitor} will answer for it here.
result: {traitor} sees it in your face, and steel is out on both sides.
"So be it," {traitor} says, and does not pretend any more.

title: The night before
Betrayed
{traitor}
text: You wake to the horses screaming. {traitor}'s blanket is cold. {traitor}'s pack is gone, and so is what you could least spare, and out in the dark there are lanterns coming, more than you can count.

It is the dead hour of the night when you understand: {traitor} is not on watch. {traitor} is not anywhere. And the fire you banked has been kicked out, so that whatever is coming will not have to see you first.
{traitor} is standing at the edge of the firelight when you wake, looking out, not at you. "I'm sorry," {they} say{s}, and is gone, and the dark comes in after {them}.
{why}

title: Word from {town}
Sold
{traitor}
text: A boy from {town} has run all day to find you, and can hardly speak for it: {traitor} rode out towards {home} two nights ago, with a lantern and no servant, and has not come back.
Word comes by a carter: {traitor} has been seen on the road to {home}, alone, by night, and nobody in {town} has had a word from {them} since.
A letter, in a hand you know: {traitor}'s. It is not for you. It was found on the road, dropped by a rider in a hurry, and it sets out everything you mean to do.
{why}

title: The way in
Unseen
Getting inside
text: {place} is watched. There are eyes at the way in, and the dark round it has been cleared so that nothing comes close unnoticed.
You lie up within sight of {place} until the light goes. Somebody keeps watch there, and changes the watch, and is careful.
Getting into {place} is the whole of it. Getting in without the alarm going up is the hard part.

label: Walk in as one of them, in your disguise.
result: Nobody stops you. Nobody even looks twice.
A nod, a grunt, and you are inside.
fail_result: A face turns. A hand goes to a hilt. "You're not one of ours."

label: Creep in by the dark side, unseen.
result: You are in, and nobody knows it.
A loose board, a shadow, a held breath, and you are past them.
fail_result: A stone turns under your foot. The shout goes up.

label: Talk your way past the watch.
result: You talk, and keep talking, and somewhere in it they stand aside.
"Go on, then," the watch says at last, sick of you.
fail_result: "Funny," the watch says. "Nobody said." And then louder: "Here! To me!"

label: Not now. Come back another night.
result: You slip away the way you came. Another night.
Not tonight. You will be back.
